definitions: A triangular or rhomboidal piece of material inserted into a seam to strengthen or enlarge a garment, such as in the underarm of a sleeve or the crotch of a pair of trousers.
A bracket or an angular piece of iron or steel used to strengthen an angle or join two plates.
examples: The dress pattern included a gusset for better movement.
She sewed a gusset into the sleeve.
The bridge structure was reinforced with gussets.
